design_principles: Player photo occupies 60-70% of vertical space, centered or slightly offset
Bold team-color gradient or ambient lighting fills the lower third as background
MATCH DAY or MATCHDAY typography is massive and dominant in the upper section
Team badges appear inline beside team names, not floating independently
Date and kickoff time are shown in small, high-contrast text in the lower zone
Bottom-left ~30% of card width stays relatively clear for text overlays
Atmospheric effects (fog, light beams, particles) add cinematic depth without cluttering
Card format is 9:16 vertical (1080x1920px) — Instagram Story format

stadium_night.trigger: Night league match, regular season fixture
stadium_night.description: Abstract cinematic stadium atmosphere. Floodlight beams cutting through dark fog. Team colors as dominant ambient glow. Dark electric atmosphere with dramatic light rays. NOT a photorealistic stadium photo — abstract, graphic, atmospheric. Center area clear for player cutout composite.
stadium_night.color_mood: Deep blues and blacks with team color accent lighting, high contrast

geometric_bold.trigger: Derby match, high-stakes local rivalry, intense inter-city competition
geometric_bold.description: Bold graphic design with sharp geometric shapes — diagonal cuts and angular divisions in team colors. No photorealism. Pure graphic power. Large flat color blocks, abstract energy patterns. Aggressive visual tension between the two team colors splitting the composition. Hard edges, no gradients.
geometric_bold.color_mood: High saturation, team colors in stark contrast, black as hard separator

action_dynamic.trigger: Cup tie, knockout stage, elimination match, playoff, FA Cup
action_dynamic.description: Motion energy — speed lines, kinetic blur, explosive light particles radiating from center. Sense of movement and adrenaline. Background suggests intense physical action. Dramatic radial composition drawing the eye to the center. Abstract but energetic. Streaks of light and color.
action_dynamic.color_mood: High contrast warm tones, whites and team colors, motion streaks

magazine_portrait.trigger: Featured player, club captain, match winner profile, award nominee
magazine_portrait.description: Premium editorial magazine cover aesthetic. Clean, sophisticated composition. Dark neutral background with one strong accent color from the team palette. Strong negative space for typography. Studio-quality lighting. No stadium elements. Feels like a Sports Illustrated or FourFourTwo cover story.
magazine_portrait.color_mood: Near-monochrome with single team color accent, elegant neutrals

celebration_vivid.trigger: Title match, season finale, promotion playoff, championship, trophy game
celebration_vivid.description: Vivid celebration energy — golden light bursts, festive atmosphere with rich saturated colors. Joy and triumph radiating from every element. Explosive warm light fills the frame. Confetti-like particle effects in team colors. Euphoric, triumphant visual energy. Feels like the moment of victory.
celebration_vivid.color_mood: Gold, team colors, bright whites, celebratory warm amber tones

cinematic_dusk.trigger: Afternoon kickoff (14:00-18:00 HKT), sunset timing, early evening match
cinematic_dusk.description: Golden hour cinematic atmosphere. Warm amber and deep orange light flooding the composition horizontally. Long dramatic shadows and silhouettes. Film-like color grading with rich tonal depth. Abstract warm light beams, bokeh, lens flares from a low sun. No specific stadium structures — pure atmospheric golden light.
cinematic_dusk.color_mood: Warm amber, burnt orange, deep shadow contrast, cinematic film grade

minimal_luxury.trigger: International competition, continental tournament, prestigious away match, AFC Champions League
minimal_luxury.description: Ultra-premium minimal aesthetic. Near-black background with subtle metallic texture. Typography is the dominant design element — bold and architectural. Sparse, deliberate composition with generous white space. Luxury brand visual language. Clean geometric accents in team colors. Feels like UEFA Champions League broadcast design.
minimal_luxury.color_mood: Near-black base, single team color metallic accent, crisp white typography
